status: Prepared only; root review and exclusive MAIN/CPU grant required before execution
purpose: One bounded clean-base full Expression runtime target observation; no isolated-case retry and no repeat of all eleven reader suites.
source_checks: Before and after, verify clean exact HEAD/tree/branch and all 10,026 tracked bytes/modes/literal symlink targets against frozen map. No source contents change.
freshness: During authorized execution only, refresh the tracked-file mtimes once and prove complete bytes/modes/aggregate unchanged before Cargo; this prevents shared-target reuse based on old checkout mtimes.
socket_preflight: Before Cargo, bind a private AF_UNIX datagram socket and an IPv4 loopback listener; stop if either is denied.
toolchain: Capture rustc -vV and require exact candidate output; native Mach-O x86_64 artifacts recorded with file and SHA256.
census: Capture actual Cargo compiler artifact, then list all/ignored cases from only the runtime libtest executable. Require its27 exact identities and zero ignored to equal the captured candidate census; bind each actual row and summary. Listing is not passing execution.
feature_comparison: Capture all actual compiler-artifact feature/profile signatures; normalize only the workspace path prefix. Compare every baseline signature with the recorded candidate reader signatures. Any difference is reported as a comparison limitation; no compiled-byte or full-resolver-graph identity claim without evidence.
failure_policy: One command once; retain ordinary exit101 with full target census as a failed observation. Timeout, abort, compile/source/census failure stops without retry. A pass never qualifies the candidate or waives its failed gate.
launch: python3 run.py --run --main-target-granted; caller must use socket-enabled execution after root grant
